[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "free-llm-models"
version = "1.0.2"
description = "A curated list of free LLM APIs and models. Query 500+ free models from 30+ providers."
readme = "README.md"
authors = [{name = "MyToolster"}]
license = {text = "MIT"}
keywords = ["llm", "free", "ai", "models", "api", "openai", "claude", "gpt"]
requires-python = ">=3.8"
classifiers = [
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Artificial Intelligence",
]

[project.scripts]
free-llm-models = "free_llm_models.cli:main"

[project.urls]
"Homepage" = "https://freellm.net"
"Repository" = "https://github.com/open-free-llm-api/free-llm-models-python"
"Bug Reports" = "https://github.com/open-free-llm-api/free-llm-models-python/issues"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["."]
include = ["free_llm_models*"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
free_llm_models = ["../data/models.json"]

"""free-llm-models CLI."""
import argparse
import json
import sys

from . import all as all_models, search, get, providers, by_provider, random as random_model, meta


def _print_table(models):
    if not models:
        print('No models found.')
        return
    print(f"{'Model':<35} {'Provider':<20} {'Tools':<6} {'JSON'}")
    print('-' * 70)
    for m in models:
        tools = 'yes' if m['supportsTools'] else '-'
        js = 'yes' if m['supportsJson'] else '-'
        print(f"{m['name']:<35} {m['provider']:<20} {tools:<6} {js}")


def cmd_list(args):
    models = all_models()
    if args.provider:
        models = by_provider(args.provider)
    models = models[:args.limit]
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(models, indent=2))
    else:
        _print_table(models)
        if len(models) == args.limit:
            print(f'\nShowing {args.limit}. Use --limit to see more.')


def cmd_search(args):
    models = search(args.keyword)[:20]
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(models, indent=2))
    else:
        _print_table(models)


def cmd_info(args):
    m = get(args.name)
    if not m:
        print('Model not found. Try: search <keyword>')
        return
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(m, indent=2))
        return
    print(f"""
Model:    {m['name']}
Provider: {m['provider']}
Tools:    {'yes' if m['supportsTools'] else 'no'}
JSON:     {'yes' if m['supportsJson'] else 'no'}
Released: {m['released'] or 'unknown'}

Try it free: https://freellm.net
""")


def cmd_providers(args):
    provs = providers()
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(provs, indent=2))
        return
    print(f"{'Provider':<25} {'Models'}")
    print('-' * 35)
    for p in provs:
        print(f"{p['name']:<25} {p['count']}")


def cmd_compare(args):
    ma, mb = get(args.model_a), get(args.model_b)
    if not ma or not mb:
        print('One or both models not found.')
        return
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps([ma, mb], indent=2))
        return
    fields = [('Provider', 'provider'), ('Tools', 'supportsTools'),
              ('JSON mode', 'supportsJson'), ('Released', 'released')]
    print(f"{'Field':<10} {ma['name']:<30} {mb['name']}")
    print('-' * 70)
    for label, key in fields:
        va, vb = ma[key], mb[key]
        if isinstance(va, bool):
            va, vb = 'yes' if va else 'no', 'yes' if vb else 'no'
        print(f"{label:<10} {str(va or '-'):<30} {vb or '-'}")


def cmd_random(args):
    m = random_model()
    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps(m, indent=2))
        return
    print(f"\nTry this free model: {m['name']} (provider: {m['provider']})")
    print("More: https://freellm.net\n")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='free-llm-models',
        description='Query 500+ free LLM APIs. Data from https://freellm.net',
    )
    parser.add_argument('--json', action='store_true', help='Output as JSON')
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest='cmd')

    p = sub.add_parser('list', help='List free models')
    p.add_argument('--provider', help='Filter by provider')
    p.add_argument('--limit', type=int, default=20)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_list)

    p = sub.add_parser('search', help='Search models')
    p.add_argument('keyword')
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_search)

    p = sub.add_parser('info', help='Model details')
    p.add_argument('name')
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_info)

    p = sub.add_parser('providers', help='List providers')
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_providers)

    p = sub.add_parser('compare', help='Compare two models')
    p.add_argument('model_a')
    p.add_argument('model_b')
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_compare)

    p = sub.add_parser('random', help='Random model pick')
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_random)

    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not args.cmd:
        parser.print_help()
        sys.exit(0)
    args.func(args)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# free-llm-models

[![PyPI version](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/free-llm-models.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/free-llm-models/)
[![PyPI downloads](https://img.shields.io/pypi/dm/free-llm-models.svg)](https://pypi.org/project/free-llm-models/)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)
[![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/open-free-llm-api/free-llm-models-python.svg)](https://github.com/open-free-llm-api/free-llm-models-python/stargazers)

A curated, machine-readable directory of **537+ free LLM APIs and models** from 30+ providers. Query it from your terminal or import it into your Python projects.

Data is synced daily from [FreeLLM](https://freellm.net) — the free LLM API directory with live playground. Browse the full interactive catalog at [freellm.net](https://freellm.net).

> **JavaScript user?** There's an npm twin: [`free-llm-models` on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/free-llm-models) · [GitHub](https://github.com/open-free-llm-api/free-llm-models)

## Installation

```bash
pip install free-llm-models
```

## CLI Usage

```bash
# List free models (default 20, use --limit for more)
free-llm-models list --limit 10

# Filter by provider
free-llm-models list --provider opencode

# Search by keyword
free-llm-models search claude

# Show model details
free-llm-models info kimi-k2-7-code

# List all providers with model counts
free-llm-models providers

# Compare two models side by side
free-llm-models compare kimi-k2-7-code claude-fable-5

# Get a random recommendation
free-llm-models random

# Machine-readable JSON output (great for scripts)
free-llm-models search gpt --json
```

## Python API

```python
import free_llm_models as flm

# Search models
results = flm.search('claude')

# Get a specific model
model = flm.get('kimi-k2-7-code')
print(model['provider'])  # 'opencode'

# List providers
providers = flm.providers()

# Filter by provider
models = flm.by_provider('opencode')

# Get dataset metadata
meta = flm.meta()  # {'updated', 'source', 'count'}
```

## Data

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `id` | Unique model identifier |
| `name` | Human-readable model name |
| `provider` | Provider name (e.g. `opencode`, `google-gemini`) |
| `supportsTools` | Whether the model supports function calling |
| `supportsJson` | Whether the model supports JSON mode |
| `released` | Release date (ISO 8601) |

- **537 models** across 30+ providers
- Updated: 2026-10-18
- Full interactive directory with playground: [https://freellm.net](https://freellm.net)

## Relationship with awesome-freellm-apis

This package is the machine-readable companion to [awesome-freellm-apis](https://github.com/open-free-llm-api/awesome-freellm-apis) (the curated awesome list, 4.4k+ stars).

| | awesome-freellm-apis | free-llm-models |
|---|---|---|
| Format | Human-readable awesome list | JSON data + CLI + API |
| Use case | Browse & compare in browser | Query from terminal / code |
| Data source | Same freellm.net dataset | Same freellm.net dataset |

Both are maintained by the [open-free-llm-api](https://github.com/open-free-llm-api) organization and synced from [freellm.net](https://freellm.net).

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome! See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidelines.

## Changelog

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for release history.
